description: Defines the BaseEventDelegate class which manages event notifications, including registration, dispatching, and emitter management, for app notifications within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: BaseEventDelegate
classes.description: Manages registration, dispatching, and removal of app notification emitters and events.

classes.name: EventDelegateDispatchJob
classes.description: Inner class responsible for dispatching events to app notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: HandleEvent
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle incoming events, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an event with payload to registered notifications if registered.

methods.name: DispatchToAppNotifications
methods.description: Sends event and payload to all emitters registered for the event.

methods.name: AddNotification
methods.description: Registers a new emitter for a specific event.

methods.name: IsNotificationRegistered
methods.description: Checks if a notification event is registered.

methods.name: GetEmittersForNotification
methods.description: Retrieves all emitters registered for a specific event.

methods.name: RemoveNotification
methods.description: Removes a specific emitter from an event or all events if event string is empty.
